title: SF2E level-1 chargen engine, plus a pregen-borrowing shortcut, for the battle simulator's kid stat blocks
summary: A real, tested SF2E level-1 character-creation derivation engine (tools/character-builder/), plus a LevelDB compendium-pack reader (tools/pack-extractor/) used to borrow and reflavour the game's own shipped pregens as battle-simulator test fixtures — both paths built, not just the shortcut.
description:
Ingram asked the battle simulator to stop abstracting the personnel-scale ground team (data/subsystems/day-1-ground-layer.json) as a scripted assumption and instead roll it against real level-1 character stat blocks — pointing at the live Foundry instance's 'Iconics' and 'Adventure Pregens' compendiums as a source, and explicitly asking for two things: the easy route (borrow and reflavour a pregen) AND a real process for building a character from scratch, because both have value.

Both were built:

1. **tools/pack-extractor/read-pack.mjs** — a from-scratch LevelDB write-ahead-log reader (32KB block framing, First/Middle/Last record reassembly, WriteBatch/varint decoding per leveldb/db/log_format.h), since every gamesystems/sf2e/packs/ pack ships as an uncompacted .log file with no .ldb SST tables at all. No dependency pulled in for this — the format is simple enough to implement directly, and matches how a prior session's research (design/foundry-technical-reference.md) says the same packs were parsed once before.
2. **tools/character-builder/derive.mjs** — the actual Player Core chargen steps (pg. 17-25, cited by page in the code) as pure functions: ability boosts (including the +4 level-1 cap, which reduces to a simple clamp at this level since the 'partial boost' mechanic never resolves before a level-up), HP, Perception, saves, skills, AC, Class DC. Verified correct by reproducing all six Player Core pregens' own officially published HP totals exactly (test/character-builder/kid-fixtures.test.mjs) — not just internal self-consistency.
3. **tools/character-builder/extract-pregen.mjs + build-kid-fixture.mjs** — the shortcut: resolves a pregen's ancestry/background/class boost choices (throwing on genuine ambiguity in the source data rather than silently guessing — found and handled one real case, Jaedana's Kasatha/Spacefarer boosts, via an explicit documented override) and feeds them through the same derive.mjs engine.
4. **tools/battle-simulator/data/kid-fixtures/** — the output: six kid.schema.json-shaped, schema-valid statblocks, one per SF2E Player Core class (Envoy, Mystic, Operative, Soldier, Solarian, Witchwarper), reflavoured as five ground-role placeholders plus one Frame pilot, all clearly marked 'TEST FIXTURE... not one of the six real kids' — same convention as the existing synthetic Reference Frame.
5. **tools/battle-simulator/ground-layer/resolve-ground-layer.mjs** — actually simulates the ground team: five kids roll real d20s against the subsystem's real DC 15 obstacles, in a Spot/Shepherd lane split sized proportionally to the two pools' win targets (6:8), deliberately kept separate from engine/ per the scale-separation rule. Found and fixed a real bug while building this: Perception lives outside kid.schema.json's `skills` map (its own top-level field), and the first version silently scored it as +0 for every kid, systematically undervaluing the Spot obstacle. Wired into tools/battle-simulator/scenarios/five-vehicles-one-frame.mjs, replacing the flat 'field breaks at round 2' assumption — the field now genuinely might not break within the ground team's 3-round window, a real possible outcome the old code foreclosed.

The derivation engine (not just its pregen-borrowing use here) is meant to be reusable for the real six kids' character creation later, whenever that collaborative session happens.
sourceContext: Ingram shared a screenshot of the live Foundry instance's compendium sidebar (Iconics, Adventure Pregens under a Pregenerated PCs folder) and asked for both the pregen shortcut and a real chargen process, so the ground-layer half of the Day 1 simulation could roll against something real instead of an assumption.
openSubQuestions: Should tools/character-builder/derive.mjs grow level-2+ support (the real partial-boost bookkeeping this level-1-only version deliberately skips) before it's used for the real six kids, or is that a later-level concern to add when they actually level up?

The Iconics compendium (gamesystems/sf2e/packs/iconics) was inspected and also has one level-1 pregen per class, but Adventure Pregens was used instead — no strong reason against Iconics if a future need wants named, more strongly-characterized reflavour material.
resolution: Built 2026-08-22: tools/pack-extractor/, tools/character-builder/, tools/battle-simulator/ground-layer/, tools/battle-simulator/data/kid-fixtures/*.json (6 files). Tests: test/character-builder/{derive,pack-extractor,kid-fixtures}.test.mjs, test/battle-simulator/ground-layer.test.mjs. Wired into tools/battle-simulator/scenarios/five-vehicles-one-frame.mjs and the published Contact Simulation artifact.
